votes.sql:
WITH ProductSales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS units_sold,
        MIN(o.date_order_placed) AS first_order_date,
        MAX(o.date_order_placed) AS last_order_date
    FROM Products p
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Delivered'
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
),
ProductVelocity AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        product_name,
        units_sold,
        first_order_date,
        last_order_date,
        julianday(last_order_date) - julianday(first_order_date) AS days_active,
        CASE 
            WHEN (julianday(last_order_date) - julianday(first_order_date)) > 0 
            THEN CAST(units_sold AS REAL) / (julianday(last_order_date) - julianday(first_order_date))
            ELSE CAST(units_sold AS REAL)
        END AS sales_velocity_per_day
    FROM ProductSales
)
SELECT 
    product_name,
    ROUND(sales_velocity_per_day, 4) AS estimated_daily_sales_rate
FROM ProductVelocity
ORDER BY sales_velocity_per_day DESC;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS total_sold,
        MIN(o.date_order_placed) AS min_date,
        MAX(o.date_order_placed) AS max_date
    FROM Products p
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        total_sold,
        min_date,
        max_date,
        CASE
            WHEN total_sold = 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN julianday(max_date) - julianday(min_date) = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE (julianday(max_date) - julianday(min_date)) + 1
        END AS days_span_int,
        CASE
            WHEN total_sold = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (julianday(max_date) - julianday(min_date)) + 1
        END AS days_span_real
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    CASE WHEN total_sold = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (days_span_real / total_sold) END AS estimated_exhaustion_timeline_days
FROM product_metrics
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN total_sold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    estimated_exhaustion_timeline_days ASC;

votes.sql:
WITH DeliveryMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_name AS category,
        s.shipment_tracking_number AS carrier,
        ROUND((julianday(s.shipment_date) - julianday(o.date_order_placed)), 2) AS delivery_days,
        CASE WHEN o.order_status_code = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_delivered
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Shipments s ON oi.order_id = s.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code IS NOT NULL AND s.shipment_date IS NOT NULL
),
CarrierPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        carrier,
        CAST(SUM(is_delivered) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate
    FROM DeliveryMetrics
    GROUP BY carrier
    HAVING CAST(SUM(is_delivered) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 95
)
SELECT 
    dm.category,
    dm.carrier,
    ROUND(AVG(dm.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_time_days
FROM DeliveryMetrics dm
WHERE dm.carrier IN (SELECT carrier FROM CarrierPerformance)
GROUP BY dm.category, dm.carrier

WITH shipment_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_name AS product_category,
        s.shipment_tracking_number AS carrier,
        julianday(s.shipment_date) - julianday(o.date_order_placed) AS delivery_days,
        CASE WHEN s.shipment_date <= i.invoice_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_time
    FROM Shipments s
    JOIN Orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Invoices i ON s.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    carrier,
    AVG(delivery_days) AS average_delivery_time_days
FROM shipment_data
GROUP BY product_category, carrier
HAVING (SUM(on_time) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) > 0.95;

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy(root_id, desc_id) AS (
        SELECT product_id, product_id FROM Products
        UNION ALL
        SELECT h.root_id, p.product_id
        FROM hierarchy h
        JOIN Products p ON p.parent_product_id = h.desc_id
    ),
    revenue AS (
        SELECT
            h.root_id,
            c.country,
            SUM(p.product_price) AS revenue
        FROM hierarchy h
        JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = h.desc_id
        JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
        GROUP BY h.root_id, c.country
    )
SELECT
    pr.product_name,
    r.country,
    r.revenue
FROM revenue r
JOIN Products pr ON pr.product_id = r.root_id
ORDER BY pr.product_name, r.country;

/* Note: This schema does not contain any product ratings or reviews tables/columns. */
/* To answer this question accurately, the following additional tables would be needed: */
/* 1. A Product_Ratings table with columns: product_id, rating_value, review_id */
/* 2. A Products table with a category identifier (currently none exists) */
/* 
 * Assuming hypothetical tables Product_Ratings(product_id, rating, review_id) and Products(category) existed:
 */
WITH ProductRatingsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        AVG(pr.rating) AS avg_rating,
        COUNT(pr.review_id) AS total_reviews
    FROM Product_Ratings pr
    INNER JOIN Products p ON pr.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY pr.product_id, p.product_name, p.category
),
RankedProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        product_name,
        avg_rating,
        total_reviews,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY avg_rating DESC) AS rank_in_category
    FROM ProductRatingsCTE
)
SELECT 
    product_name,
    avg_rating,
    total_reviews
FROM RankedProducts
WHERE rank_in_category <= 3;

WITH returned_items AS (
    SELECT oi.order_item_id,
           oi.product_id,
           o.customer_id,
           o.date_order_placed,
           s.shipment_date
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Shipment_Items si ON oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id
    JOIN Shipments s ON si.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
    WHERE oi.order_item_status_code = 'Returned'
      AND o.date_order_placed >= date('now', '-1 year')
)

-- Products returned most often in the last year
SELECT p.product_name,
       COUNT(*) AS return_count
FROM returned_items ri
JOIN Products p ON ri.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY return_count DESC;

-- Average time between order date and return shipment date, broken down by customer age groups
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(c.date_of_birth))/365.25 < 20 THEN 'Under 20'
        WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(c.date_of_birth))/365.25 < 30 THEN '20-29'
        WHEN (julianday('now') - julianday(c.date_of_birth))/365.25 < 40 THEN '30-39'
        ELSE '40+'
    END AS age_group,
    AVG(julianday(ri.shipment_date) - julianday(ri.date_order_placed)) AS avg_days_between_order_and_return
FROM returned_items ri
JOIN Customers c ON ri.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

votes.sql:
WITH supplier_lead AS (
    SELECT p.parent_product_id AS supplier_id,
           AVG(julianday(sh.shipment_date) - julianday(o.date_order_placed)) AS avg_lead_days
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Shipments sh ON sh.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.parent_product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND sh.shipment_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.parent_product_id
)
SELECT p.product_name,
       s.product_name AS supplier_name,
       sl.avg_lead_days
FROM Products p
LEFT JOIN Products s ON p.parent_product_id = s.product_id
LEFT JOIN supplier_lead sl ON p.parent_product_id = sl.supplier_id;

WITH delivery_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_size,
        strftime('%Y-%m', s.shipment_date) AS shipment_month,
        p.product_price AS item_value
    FROM Order_Items oi
    INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    INNER JOIN Shipments s ON oi.order_id = s.order_id
    WHERE oi.order_item_status_code = 'Delivered'
),
grouped_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_size,
        shipment_month,
        AVG(item_value) AS avg_item_value
    FROM delivery_metrics
    GROUP BY product_size, shipment_month
)
SELECT 
    product_size,
    shipment_month,
    avg_item_value,
    SUM(avg_item_value) OVER (ORDER BY product_size || '-' || shipment_month) AS cumulative_weight
FROM grouped_data
ORDER BY product_size || '-' || shipment_month;

WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT
        p."product_size",
        strftime('%Y-%m', s."shipment_date") AS "shipment_month",
        p."product_price" AS weight
    FROM "Order_Items" oi
    JOIN "Products" p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id"
    JOIN "Shipment_Items" si ON oi."order_item_id" = si."order_item_id"
    JOIN "Shipments" s ON si."shipment_id" = s."shipment_id"
    WHERE oi."order_item_status_code" = 'Delivered'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        "product_size",
        "shipment_month",
        AVG(weight) AS avg_weight,
        SUM(weight) AS total_weight
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY "product_size", "shipment_month"
)
SELECT
    "product_size",
    "shipment_month",
    avg_weight,
    SUM(total_weight) OVER (ORDER BY date("shipment_month" || '-01') ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_weight_shipped
FROM grouped
ORDER BY "product_size", "shipment_month";
}
